queries.description: Returns the MySQL/MariaDB server version string. Essential for determining feature compatibility and version-specific behavior.

scaling_factor.note: Reads a server variable; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT VERSION() AS version

queries.description: Returns the Aurora MySQL engine version. Useful for identifying Aurora-specific features and patch levels.

scaling_factor.note: Reads an Aurora function; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT aurora_version() AS aurora_version

queries.description: Returns the Aurora server ID for this instance. Identifies whether this is a writer or reader in the cluster.

scaling_factor.note: Reads a server variable; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@aurora_server_id as aurora_server_id

queries.description: Counts writer and reader instances in the Aurora cluster using REPLICA_HOST_STATUS. Provides cluster topology overview.

scaling_factor.note: Reads Aurora internal metadata table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT (SELECT count(1) FROM information_schema.REPLICA_HOST_STATUS WHERE SESSION_ID='MASTER_SESSION_ID') AS writer_count, (SELECT count(1) FROM information_schema.REPLICA_HOST_STATUS WHERE SESSION_ID!='MASTER_SESSION_ID') AS reader_count, (SELECT count(1) FROM information_schema.REPLICA_HOST_STATUS) AS total_instances

queries.description: Returns the server hostname. Useful for identifying which host this collection was run against.

scaling_factor.note: Reads a server variable; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@hostname AS hostname

queries.description: Returns the globally unique server UUID. Used to identify the server in replication topologies.

scaling_factor.note: Reads a server variable; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@server_uuid AS server_uuid

queries.description: Returns the MySQL listening port number.

scaling_factor.note: Reads a server variable; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@port AS port

queries.description: Returns the server data directory path.

scaling_factor.note: Reads a server variable; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@datadir AS datadir

queries.description: Returns the server default character set and collation.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@character_set_server AS character_set, @@collation_server AS collation

queries.description: Returns the system and session time zone settings.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@system_time_zone AS system_time_zone, @@time_zone AS session_time_zone

queries.description: Returns server uptime in seconds since last restart.

scaling_factor.note: Reads a server status counter; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Uptime'

queries.description: Checks whether the server is in read-only mode. Important for identifying writer vs reader roles.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@read_only AS read_only, @@innodb_read_only AS innodb_read_only

queries.description: Checks whether Performance Schema is enabled. Many collector queries depend on this.

scaling_factor.note: Reads a server variable; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@performance_schema AS performance_schema_enabled

queries.description: Lists key Performance Schema consumer states. Shows whether thread and wait instrumentation is active.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema setup table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT NAME, ENABLED FROM performance_schema.setup_consumers WHERE NAME IN ('thread_instrumentation', 'global_instrumentation', 'events_waits_current')

queries.description: Summarizes Performance Schema instrument classes (memory, wait/io, wait/synch, wait/lock) with enabled counts.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema setup table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(NAME, '/', 1) AS instrument_class, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(IF(ENABLED='YES',1,0)) AS enabled_count FROM performance_schema.setup_instruments WHERE NAME LIKE 'memory/%' OR NAME LIKE 'wait/io/%' OR NAME LIKE 'wait/synch/%' OR NAME LIKE 'wait/lock/%' GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(NAME, '/', 1) ORDER BY instrument_class

queries.description: Lists server variables that differ from compiled defaults, showing who changed them and when. Critical for configuration auditing.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema variables_info and global_variables tables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT vi.VARIABLE_NAME, gv.VARIABLE_VALUE, vi.MIN_VALUE, vi.MAX_VALUE, vi.VARIABLE_SOURCE, IFNULL(CONCAT(vi.SET_USER, '@', vi.SET_HOST), 'N/A') AS SET_BY, IFNULL(vi.SET_TIME, 'N/A') AS SET_TIME, IFNULL(vi.VARIABLE_PATH, '') AS CONFIG_PATH FROM performance_schema.variables_info vi JOIN performance_schema.global_variables gv ON vi.VARIABLE_NAME = gv.VARIABLE_NAME WHERE vi.VARIABLE_SOURCE != 'COMPILED' AND vi.VARIABLE_NAME NOT IN ('bind_address', 'mysqlx_port', 'mysqlx_socket', 'relay_log', 'report_host', 'report_port', 'server_id', 'tmpdir', 'basedir', 'datadir', 'log_error', 'pid_file', 'plugin_dir', 'socket') ORDER BY CASE vi.VARIABLE_SOURCE WHEN 'PERSISTED' THEN 1 WHEN 'DYNAMIC' THEN 2 WHEN 'EXPLICIT' THEN 3 WHEN 'COMMAND_LINE' THEN 4 WHEN 'GLOBAL' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, vi.VARIABLE_NAME

queries.description: Lists all user-created schemas, excluding system schemas.

scaling_factor.note: Reads I_S.SCHEMATA data dictionary view (MySQL 8.0+); scales with number of schemas.

queries.command: SELECT schema_name AS database_name FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY schema_name

queries.description: Returns general log, slow query log, and long_query_time settings.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@general_log AS general_log, @@slow_query_log AS slow_query_log, @@long_query_time AS long_query_time

queries.description: Determines server replication role (SOURCE/REPLICA/STANDALONE) using information_schema.processlist. MariaDB variant.

scaling_factor.note: Queries information_schema.processlist which holds the global thread manager mutex; scales with active threads and can cause contention on busy systems.

queries.command: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE user = 'system user' AND command IN ('Slave_IO', 'Slave_SQL')) > 0 THEN 'REPLICA' WHEN @@log_bin = 1 THEN 'SOURCE' ELSE 'STANDALONE' END AS replication_role, @@log_bin AS log_bin_enabled

queries.description: Determines server replication role (SOURCE/REPLICA/STANDALONE) using information_schema.processlist. MySQL/Aurora variant when Performance Schema is disabled.

scaling_factor.note: Queries information_schema.processlist which holds the global thread manager mutex; scales with active threads and can cause contention on busy systems.

queries.command: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE user = 'system user' AND command IN ('Slave_IO', 'Slave_SQL')) > 0 THEN 'REPLICA' WHEN @@log_bin = 1 THEN 'SOURCE' ELSE 'STANDALONE' END AS replication_role, @@log_bin AS log_bin_enabled

queries.description: Determines server replication role (SOURCE/REPLICA/STANDALONE) using Performance Schema. MySQL/Aurora variant when Performance Schema is enabled - avoids the processlist global mutex.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema replication_connection_status table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM performance_schema.replication_connection_status) > 0 THEN 'REPLICA' WHEN @@log_bin = 1 THEN 'SOURCE' ELSE 'STANDALONE' END AS replication_role, @@log_bin AS log_bin_enabled

queries.description: Lists currently connected replica threads (Binlog Dump). Shows which replicas are actively replicating from this source.

scaling_factor.note: Queries information_schema.processlist which holds the global thread manager mutex; scales with active threads and can cause contention on busy systems.

queries.command: SELECT ID AS process_id, USER, HOST, COMMAND AS state, TIME AS time_sec FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE COMMAND = 'Binlog Dump' OR COMMAND = 'Binlog Dump GTID'

queries.description: Shows current binary log file and position. MariaDB variant using SHOW MASTER STATUS.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server status; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW MASTER STATUS

queries.description: Shows current binary log file and position. MySQL/Aurora variant for versions before 8.3 using SHOW MASTER STATUS.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server status; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW MASTER STATUS

queries.description: Shows current binary log file and position. MySQL/Aurora 8.3+ variant using SHOW BINARY LOG STATUS.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server status; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW BINARY LOG STATUS

queries.description: Returns GTID mode and consistency enforcement settings. Essential for GTID-based replication configuration review.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@gtid_mode AS gtid_mode, @@enforce_gtid_consistency AS enforce_gtid_consistency

queries.description: Shows detailed replica status including IO/SQL thread state, lag, and errors. MySQL/Aurora 8.0.23+ variant using SHOW REPLICA STATUS.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server replication status; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW REPLICA STATUS

queries.description: Shows detailed replica status. MariaDB variant using SHOW SLAVE STATUS.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server replication status; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW SLAVE STATUS

queries.description: Shows detailed replica status. MySQL/Aurora pre-8.0.24 variant using SHOW SLAVE STATUS.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server replication status; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW SLAVE STATUS

queries.description: Returns replication configuration parameters including binlog format, parallel workers, and GTID settings. MySQL/Aurora pre-8.1 variant with legacy variable names.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@log_bin AS log_bin, @@binlog_format AS binlog_format, @@sync_binlog AS sync_binlog, @@gtid_mode AS gtid_mode, @@enforce_gtid_consistency AS enforce_gtid_consistency, @@slave_parallel_workers AS replica_parallel_workers, @@slave_parallel_type AS replica_parallel_type, @@slave_preserve_commit_order AS replica_preserve_commit_order, @@binlog_transaction_dependency_tracking AS binlog_transaction_dependency_tracking, @@binlog_group_commit_sync_delay AS binlog_group_commit_sync_delay, @@binlog_group_commit_sync_no_delay_count AS binlog_group_commit_sync_no_delay_count, @@transaction_write_set_extraction AS transaction_write_set_extraction, @@innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit AS innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit

queries.description: Returns replication configuration parameters. MySQL/Aurora 8.1+ variant with renamed replica_* variables.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@log_bin AS log_bin, @@binlog_format AS binlog_format, @@sync_binlog AS sync_binlog, @@gtid_mode AS gtid_mode, @@enforce_gtid_consistency AS enforce_gtid_consistency, @@replica_parallel_workers AS replica_parallel_workers, @@replica_parallel_type AS replica_parallel_type, @@replica_preserve_commit_order AS replica_preserve_commit_order, @@binlog_group_commit_sync_delay AS binlog_group_commit_sync_delay, @@binlog_group_commit_sync_no_delay_count AS binlog_group_commit_sync_no_delay_count, @@innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit AS innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit

queries.description: Returns replication configuration parameters. MariaDB variant with MariaDB-specific parallel replication variables.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@log_bin AS log_bin, @@binlog_format AS binlog_format, @@sync_binlog AS sync_binlog, @@slave_parallel_threads AS replica_parallel_workers, @@slave_parallel_mode AS replica_parallel_type, @@innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit AS innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit

queries.description: Counts active replication channels. Useful for multi-source replication setups.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema replication_connection_status table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT COUNT(*) AS channel_count FROM performance_schema.replication_connection_status

queries.description: Shows replication applier status per channel including service state and retry counts.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema replication_applier_status table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT CHANNEL_NAME, SERVICE_STATE, REMAINING_DELAY, COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_RETRIES FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status

queries.description: Shows replication connection status per channel including source UUID and last errors.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema replication_connection_status table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT CHANNEL_NAME, SOURCE_UUID, SERVICE_STATE, RECEIVED_TRANSACTION_SET, LAST_ERROR_NUMBER, LAST_ERROR_MESSAGE FROM performance_schema.replication_connection_status

queries.description: Calculates replication lag using Performance Schema coordinator and connection timestamps. Most accurate method for MySQL/Aurora with PFS enabled.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema replication tables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT coord.CHANNEL_NAME, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, coord.LAST_PROCESSED_TRANSACTION_ORIGINAL_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP, NOW()) AS applier_lag_sec, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, conn.LAST_QUEUED_TRANSACTION_START_QUEUE_TIMESTAMP, NOW()) AS queue_lag_sec, appl.REMAINING_DELAY AS remaining_delay_sec FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status_by_coordinator coord LEFT JOIN performance_schema.replication_connection_status conn USING (CHANNEL_NAME) LEFT JOIN performance_schema.replication_applier_status appl USING (CHANNEL_NAME)

queries.description: Shows replication lag via SHOW SLAVE STATUS. MySQL/Aurora pre-8.1 fallback when Performance Schema is disabled.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server replication status; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW SLAVE STATUS

queries.description: Shows replication lag via SHOW REPLICA STATUS. MySQL/Aurora 8.1+ fallback when Performance Schema is disabled.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server replication status; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW REPLICA STATUS

queries.description: Shows replication lag via SHOW SLAVE STATUS. MariaDB variant.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server replication status; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW SLAVE STATUS

queries.description: Shows Aurora Global Database replication status including per-instance lag and LSN positions.

scaling_factor.note: Reads Aurora internal metadata table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT SERVER_ID, SESSION_ID, LAST_UPDATE_TIMESTAMP, REPLICA_LAG_IN_MILLISECONDS, OLDEST_READ_VIEW_TRX_ID, OLDEST_READ_VIEW_LSN FROM information_schema.replica_host_status

queries.description: Returns key server metrics: QPS, uptime, slow queries, thread counts, and aborted connections. Quick health snapshot.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Queries', 'Uptime', 'Slow_queries', 'Threads_connected', 'Threads_running', 'Aborted_connects', 'Aborted_clients')

queries.description: Shows all Com_* status counters for query type distribution (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, etc.).

scaling_factor.note: Reads server status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS LIKE 'Com%'

queries.description: Finds tables with InnoDB persistent statistics older than 7 days. Stale stats can cause poor query plans.

scaling_factor.note: Reads InnoDB statistics dictionary tables directly; fast.

queries.command: SELECT database_name, table_name, last_update FROM mysql.innodb_table_stats WHERE database_name NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') AND last_update < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY last_update

queries.description: Breaks down query types (insert/select/update/delete/commit/rollback) with per-second rates from Performance Schema.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema summary table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(EVENT_NAME, '/', -1) AS query_type, COUNT_STAR AS total_count, ROUND(COUNT_STAR / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Uptime'), 2) AS per_second FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE EVENT_NAME IN ('statement/sql/insert', 'statement/sql/select', 'statement/sql/update', 'statement/sql/delete', 'statement/sql/commit', 'statement/sql/rollback') AND COUNT_STAR > 0 ORDER BY COUNT_STAR DESC

queries.description: Shows open and opened table counts. High Opened_tables relative to Open_tables suggests table_open_cache is too small.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Open_tables', 'Opened_tables')

queries.description: Returns table_open_cache and table_open_cache_instances settings.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@table_open_cache AS table_open_cache, @@table_open_cache_instances AS table_open_cache_instances

queries.description: Calculates the ratio of disk-based temporary tables to total temporary tables. High ratios indicate tmp_table_size or max_heap_table_size may need tuning.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT (SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_tables') AS created_tmp_tables, (SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_disk_tables') AS created_tmp_disk_tables, ROUND((SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_disk_tables') / NULLIF((SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_tables'), 0) * 100, 2) AS disk_tmp_table_pct

queries.description: Shows whether Aurora Parallel Query is enabled.

scaling_factor.note: Reads a server variable; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT 'aurora_parallel_query' AS Variable_name, @@aurora_parallel_query AS Value, 'Enables parallel query optimization. When ON, eligible queries use parallel processing across storage nodes.' AS Description

queries.description: Shows Aurora Parallel Query metrics including concurrent requests, throttling, and reasons queries were not parallelized.

scaling_factor.note: Reads Aurora-specific Performance Schema status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE, CASE VARIABLE_NAME WHEN 'Aurora_pq_max_concurrent_requests' THEN 'Maximum concurrent parallel query sessions allowed (based on instance class)' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_request_in_progress' THEN 'Number of parallel query sessions currently running' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_request_attempted' THEN 'Total parallel query sessions requested since restart' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_request_executed' THEN 'Total parallel query sessions successfully executed' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_request_failed' THEN 'Total parallel query sessions that failed' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_request_throttled' THEN 'Requests rejected due to concurrency limit' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_request_not_chosen' THEN 'Total requests where parallel query was not chosen' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_request_not_chosen_high_buffer_pool_pct' THEN 'Not chosen because data already cached in buffer pool' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_request_not_chosen_small_table' THEN 'Not chosen because table is too small' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_request_not_chosen_long_trx' THEN 'Not chosen due to long-running transaction' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_request_not_chosen_below_min_rows' THEN 'Not chosen because too few rows' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_pages_pushed_down' THEN 'Pages processed at storage layer (avoiding network transfer)' WHEN 'Aurora_pq_bytes_returned' THEN 'Bytes returned from storage to head node' ELSE 'Aurora parallel query metric' END AS Details FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Aurora_pq_max_concurrent_requests', 'Aurora_pq_request_in_progress', 'Aurora_pq_request_attempted', 'Aurora_pq_request_executed', 'Aurora_pq_request_failed', 'Aurora_pq_request_throttled', 'Aurora_pq_request_not_chosen', 'Aurora_pq_request_not_chosen_high_buffer_pool_pct', 'Aurora_pq_request_not_chosen_small_table', 'Aurora_pq_request_not_chosen_long_trx', 'Aurora_pq_request_not_chosen_below_min_rows', 'Aurora_pq_pages_pushed_down', 'Aurora_pq_bytes_returned') ORDER BY VARIABLE_NAME

queries.description: Shows sizes of major global memory buffers (buffer pool, log buffer, key buffer, temp table limits). MySQL/Aurora variant includes TempTable engine.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT 'InnoDB Buffer Pool' AS 'Buffer', ROUND(@@innodb_buffer_pool_size / 1073741824, 2) AS 'Size (GB)', 'Caches InnoDB data and indexes (most important)' AS 'Purpose' UNION ALL SELECT 'InnoDB Log Buffer', ROUND(@@innodb_log_buffer_size / 1073741824, 4), 'Buffers redo log writes' UNION ALL SELECT 'Key Buffer', ROUND(@@key_buffer_size / 1073741824, 2), 'Caches MyISAM indexes (not used if only InnoDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'TempTable Max RAM', ROUND(@@temptable_max_ram / 1073741824, 2), 'Max memory for TempTable storage engine' UNION ALL SELECT 'Tmp Table Size', ROUND(@@tmp_table_size / 1073741824, 2), 'Max size of internal in-memory temp tables' UNION ALL SELECT 'Max Heap Table Size', ROUND(@@max_heap_table_size / 1073741824, 2), 'Max size for user-created MEMORY tables'

queries.description: Shows sizes of major global memory buffers. MariaDB variant (no TempTable engine).

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT 'InnoDB Buffer Pool' AS 'Buffer', ROUND(@@innodb_buffer_pool_size / 1073741824, 2) AS 'Size (GB)', 'Caches InnoDB data and indexes (most important)' AS 'Purpose' UNION ALL SELECT 'InnoDB Log Buffer', ROUND(@@innodb_log_buffer_size / 1073741824, 4), 'Buffers redo log writes' UNION ALL SELECT 'Key Buffer', ROUND(@@key_buffer_size / 1073741824, 2), 'Caches MyISAM indexes (not used if only InnoDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'Tmp Table Size', ROUND(@@tmp_table_size / 1073741824, 2), 'Max size of internal in-memory temp tables' UNION ALL SELECT 'Max Heap Table Size', ROUND(@@max_heap_table_size / 1073741824, 2), 'Max size for user-created MEMORY tables'

queries.description: Shows per-connection buffer sizes and estimated max memory if all connections use them simultaneously.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT 'Sort Buffer' AS 'Buffer', ROUND(@@sort_buffer_size / 1048576, 2) AS 'Size (MB)', ROUND((@@sort_buffer_size * @@max_connections) / 1073741824, 2) AS 'Estimated Max Connections Memory', 'Used for ORDER BY and GROUP BY' AS 'Purpose' UNION ALL SELECT 'Join Buffer', ROUND(@@join_buffer_size / 1048576, 2), ROUND((@@join_buffer_size * @@max_connections) / 1073741824, 2), 'Used for joins without indexes' UNION ALL SELECT 'Read Buffer', ROUND(@@read_buffer_size / 1048576, 2), ROUND((@@read_buffer_size * @@max_connections) / 1073741824, 2), 'Sequential table scans' UNION ALL SELECT 'Read RND Buffer', ROUND(@@read_rnd_buffer_size / 1048576, 2), ROUND((@@read_rnd_buffer_size * @@max_connections) / 1073741824, 2), 'Sorted reads' UNION ALL SELECT 'Binlog Cache', ROUND(@@binlog_cache_size / 1048576, 2), ROUND((@@binlog_cache_size * @@max_connections) / 1073741824, 2), 'Transaction binlog cache'

queries.description: Calculates total per-connection memory estimate and worst-case memory usage at max_connections.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT ROUND((@@sort_buffer_size + @@join_buffer_size + @@read_buffer_size + @@read_rnd_buffer_size + @@binlog_cache_size) / 1048576, 2) AS 'Per Connection (MB)', @@max_connections AS 'Max Connections', ROUND(((@@sort_buffer_size + @@join_buffer_size + @@read_buffer_size + @@read_rnd_buffer_size + @@binlog_cache_size) * @@max_connections) / 1073741824, 2) AS 'Estimated Max Connections Memory'

queries.description: Lists all memory allocations tracked by Performance Schema, sorted by current usage. Shows where memory is being consumed.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema memory summary table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT EVENT_NAME AS 'Component', CONCAT(ROUND(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'Current Alloc', CURRENT_COUNT_USED AS 'Current Count', CONCAT(ROUND(HIGH_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'High Watermark', HIGH_COUNT_USED AS 'High Count' FROM performance_schema.memory_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED > 0 ORDER BY CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED DESC

queries.description: Shows total memory allocated and high watermark as tracked by Performance Schema.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema memory summary table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) / 1073741824, 2), ' GB') AS 'Total Allocated', CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(HIGH_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) / 1073741824, 2), ' GB') AS 'High Watermark' FROM performance_schema.memory_summary_global_by_event_name

queries.description: Aggregates memory usage by component (memory/innodb, memory/sql, etc.). Identifies which subsystems consume the most memory.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema memory summary table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(EVENT_NAME, '/', 2) AS 'Component', CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'Current Alloc', COUNT(*) AS 'Event Count', CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(HIGH_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'High Watermark' FROM performance_schema.memory_summary_global_by_event_name GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(EVENT_NAME, '/', 2) ORDER BY SUM(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) DESC

queries.description: Shows memory usage per foreground thread. Identifies connections consuming excessive memory.

scaling_factor.note: Reads Performance Schema threads table; scales with thread count but negligible overhead as it uses the safe mutex-free PFS interface.

queries.command: SELECT t.THREAD_ID, t.PROCESSLIST_USER, t.PROCESSLIST_HOST, SUM(m.CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) AS memory_bytes FROM performance_schema.threads t JOIN performance_schema.memory_summary_by_thread_by_event_name m ON t.THREAD_ID = m.THREAD_ID WHERE t.TYPE='FOREGROUND' and t.PROCESSLIST_COMMAND != 'Daemon' GROUP BY t.THREAD_ID, t.PROCESSLIST_USER, t.PROCESSLIST_HOST ORDER BY memory_bytes DESC

queries.description: Aggregates memory usage by user account.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema memory summary by user table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT USER, SUM(CURRENT_COUNT_USED) AS 'Count', CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'Current Alloc' FROM performance_schema.memory_summary_by_user_by_event_name WHERE USER IS NOT NULL GROUP BY USER ORDER BY SUM(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) DESC

queries.description: Shows InnoDB buffer pool statistics per pool instance: total pages, free buffers, dirty pages, and pending I/O.

scaling_factor.note: Reads InnoDB internal metrics from information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT POOL_ID, POOL_SIZE, FREE_BUFFERS, DATABASE_PAGES, OLD_DATABASE_PAGES, MODIFIED_DATABASE_PAGES, PENDING_DECOMPRESS, PENDING_READS, PENDING_FLUSH_LRU, PENDING_FLUSH_LIST FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats

queries.description: Shows memory usage for key SQL components: TABLE objects, temp tables, stored procedures, prepared statements, and THD allocations.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema memory summary table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT EVENT_NAME AS 'Event Name', CONCAT(ROUND(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'Current Alloc', CURRENT_COUNT_USED AS 'Current Count', CONCAT(ROUND(HIGH_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'High Watermark', CONCAT(ROUND(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED / NULLIF(CURRENT_COUNT_USED, 0) / 1024, 2), ' KB') AS 'Avg per Item' FROM performance_schema.memory_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE EVENT_NAME IN ('memory/sql/TABLE', 'memory/temptable/physical_ram', 'memory/sql/sp_head::main_mem_root', 'memory/sql/String::value', 'memory/sql/Prepared_statement::main_mem_root', 'memory/sql/THD::main_mem_root', 'memory/sql/Prepared_statement::infrastructure') ORDER BY CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED DESC

queries.description: Calculates average memory per connection and total connection memory footprint.

scaling_factor.note: Reads Performance Schema threads table; scales with thread count but negligible overhead as it uses the safe mutex-free PFS interface.

queries.command: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_schema.threads WHERE TYPE='FOREGROUND' AND PROCESSLIST_COMMAND != 'Daemon') AS 'Current Connections', @@max_connections AS 'Max Connections', CONCAT(ROUND((SELECT SUM(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) FROM performance_schema.memory_summary_by_thread_by_event_name WHERE THREAD_ID IN (SELECT THREAD_ID FROM performance_schema.threads WHERE TYPE='FOREGROUND' AND PROCESSLIST_COMMAND != 'Daemon')) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_schema.threads WHERE TYPE='FOREGROUND' AND PROCESSLIST_COMMAND != 'Daemon'), 0) / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'Avg Memory per Connection', CONCAT(ROUND((SELECT SUM(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) FROM performance_schema.memory_summary_by_thread_by_event_name WHERE THREAD_ID IN (SELECT THREAD_ID FROM performance_schema.threads WHERE TYPE='FOREGROUND' AND PROCESSLIST_COMMAND != 'Daemon')) / 1073741824, 2), ' GB') AS 'Total Connection Memory'

queries.description: Shows temp table configuration and disk spill ratio. MySQL/Aurora 8.0.23+ variant includes temptable_max_ram.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables and status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT CONCAT(ROUND(@@tmp_table_size / 1048576, 0), ' MB') AS 'tmp_table_size', CONCAT(ROUND(@@max_heap_table_size / 1048576, 0), ' MB') AS 'max_heap_table_size', CONCAT(ROUND(@@temptable_max_ram / 1048576, 0), ' MB') AS 'temptable_max_ram', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_tables') AS 'Created Tmp Tables', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_disk_tables') AS 'Created Tmp Disk Tables', CONCAT(ROUND((SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_disk_tables') / NULLIF((SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_tables'), 0) * 100, 2), '%') AS 'Disk Tmp Table %'

queries.description: Shows temp table configuration and disk spill ratio. MySQL/Aurora pre-8.0.23 variant (no temptable_max_ram).

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables and status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT CONCAT(ROUND(@@tmp_table_size / 1048576, 0), ' MB') AS 'tmp_table_size', CONCAT(ROUND(@@max_heap_table_size / 1048576, 0), ' MB') AS 'max_heap_table_size', 'N/A' AS 'temptable_max_ram', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_tables') AS 'Created Tmp Tables', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_disk_tables') AS 'Created Tmp Disk Tables', CONCAT(ROUND((SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_disk_tables') / NULLIF((SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_tables'), 0) * 100, 2), '%') AS 'Disk Tmp Table %'

queries.description: Shows temp table configuration and disk spill ratio. MariaDB variant (no TempTable engine).

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables and status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT CONCAT(ROUND(@@tmp_table_size / 1048576, 0), ' MB') AS 'tmp_table_size', CONCAT(ROUND(@@max_heap_table_size / 1048576, 0), ' MB') AS 'max_heap_table_size', 'N/A' AS 'temptable_max_ram', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_tables') AS 'Created Tmp Tables', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_disk_tables') AS 'Created Tmp Disk Tables', CONCAT(ROUND((SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_disk_tables') / NULLIF((SELECT CAST(VARIABLE_VALUE AS UNSIGNED) FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Created_tmp_tables'), 0) * 100, 2), '%') AS 'Disk Tmp Table %'

queries.description: Shows current and peak memory usage of the TempTable storage engine.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema memory summary table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT EVENT_NAME AS 'Event', CONCAT(ROUND(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'Current Alloc', CONCAT(ROUND(HIGH_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'High Watermark' FROM performance_schema.memory_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE EVENT_NAME = 'memory/temptable/physical_ram'

queries.description: Shows sort buffer, join buffer, read buffer, and read_rnd_buffer sizes.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT CONCAT(ROUND(@@sort_buffer_size / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'sort_buffer_size', CONCAT(ROUND(@@join_buffer_size / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'join_buffer_size', CONCAT(ROUND(@@read_buffer_size / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'read_buffer_size', CONCAT(ROUND(@@read_rnd_buffer_size / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'read_rnd_buffer_size', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Sort_merge_passes') AS 'Sort Merge Passes', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Sort_range') AS 'Sort Range', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Sort_scan') AS 'Sort Scan'

queries.description: Comprehensive buffer pool overview: size, instances, page counts, hit rate, and dirty page percentage. MySQL/Aurora variant.

scaling_factor.note: Reads InnoDB internal metrics and Performance Schema status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT CONCAT(ROUND(@@innodb_buffer_pool_size / 1073741824, 2)) AS 'Buffer Pool Size (GB)', @@innodb_buffer_pool_instances AS 'Buffer Pool Instances', (SELECT SUM(POOL_SIZE) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats) AS 'Total Pages', (SELECT SUM(DATABASE_PAGES) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats) AS 'Data Pages', (SELECT SUM(MODIFIED_DATABASE_PAGES) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats) AS 'Dirty Pages', (SELECT SUM(FREE_BUFFERS) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats) AS 'Free Pages', CONCAT(ROUND((1 - (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads') / NULLIF((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests'), 0)) * 100, 2), '%') AS 'Buffer Pool Hit Rate', CONCAT(ROUND((SELECT SUM(MODIFIED_DATABASE_PAGES) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(DATABASE_PAGES) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats), 0) * 100, 2), '%') AS 'Dirty Page %'

queries.description: Comprehensive buffer pool overview. MariaDB variant (no buffer pool instances).

scaling_factor.note: Reads InnoDB internal metrics and Performance Schema status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT CONCAT(ROUND(@@innodb_buffer_pool_size / 1073741824, 2)) AS 'Buffer Pool Size (GB)', 'NA' AS 'Buffer Pool Instances', (SELECT SUM(POOL_SIZE) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats) AS 'Total Pages', (SELECT SUM(DATABASE_PAGES) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats) AS 'Data Pages', (SELECT SUM(MODIFIED_DATABASE_PAGES) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats) AS 'Dirty Pages', (SELECT SUM(FREE_BUFFERS) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats) AS 'Free Pages', CONCAT(ROUND((1 - (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads') / NULLIF((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests'), 0)) * 100, 2), '%') AS 'Buffer Pool Hit Rate', CONCAT(ROUND((SELECT SUM(MODIFIED_DATABASE_PAGES) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(DATABASE_PAGES) FROM information_schema.innodb_buffer_pool_stats), 0) * 100, 2), '%') AS 'Dirty Page %'

queries.description: Identifies queries consuming the most memory using MAX_TOTAL_MEMORY from statement digests. Requires MySQL 8.0.16+.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema summary table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME AS 'Schema', LEFT(DIGEST_TEXT, 80) AS 'Query Digest (first 80 chars)', COUNT_STAR AS 'Exec Count', CONCAT(ROUND(MAX_CONTROLLED_MEMORY / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'Max Controlled Memory', CONCAT(ROUND(MAX_TOTAL_MEMORY / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS 'Max Total Memory', FIRST_SEEN AS 'First Seen', LAST_SEEN AS 'Last Seen' FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE MAX_TOTAL_MEMORY > 0 ORDER BY MAX_TOTAL_MEMORY DESC

queries.description: Shows total memory consumed by Performance Schema itself.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema memory summary table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT 'Performance Schema Memory' AS metric_name, CONCAT(ROUND(SUM(CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED) / 1048576, 2), ' MB') AS value FROM performance_schema.memory_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE EVENT_NAME LIKE 'memory/performance_schema/%'

queries.description: Shows total memory allocated as reported by sys.memory_global_total, plus memory instrument counts.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema summary table via sys view; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT total_allocated AS total_memory, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM performance_schema.setup_instruments WHERE NAME LIKE '%memory%') AS total_memory_instruments, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM performance_schema.setup_instruments WHERE NAME LIKE '%memory%' AND ENABLED = 'YES') AS enabled_memory_instruments FROM sys.memory_global_total

queries.description: Static content providing memory troubleshooting guidance and recommendations.

scaling_factor.note: Static query returning no database data.

queries.command: SELECT 'static' AS type

queries.description: Shows Aurora OOM response configuration. Controls automatic actions when the instance is low on memory.

scaling_factor.note: Reads a server variable; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT 'aurora_oom_response' AS Variable_name, @@aurora_oom_response AS Value, 'Controls automatic actions when DB instance is low on memory. Values: decline (reject new queries), kill_connect (close memory-heavy connections), kill_query (end memory-heavy queries), print (log only), tune (adjust table caches), tune_buffer_pool (shrink buffer pool)' AS Description

queries.description: Shows Aurora memory metrics including OOM status, lock manager memory, and temp table allocations.

scaling_factor.note: Reads Aurora-specific Performance Schema status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE, CASE VARIABLE_NAME WHEN 'Aurora_lockmgr_buffer_pool_memory_used' THEN 'Buffer pool memory (bytes) used by Aurora lock manager' WHEN 'Aurora_lockmgr_memory_used' THEN 'Memory (bytes) used by Aurora lock manager' WHEN 'Aurora_reserved_mem_exceeded_incidents' THEN 'Count of times memory limits exceeded since restart, triggering OOM avoidance' WHEN 'Aurora_zdr_oom_threshold' THEN 'Memory threshold (KB) for initiating zero downtime restart (ZDR)' WHEN 'aurora_oom_avoidance_recovery_state' THEN 'OOM avoidance recovery state: ACTIVE or INACTIVE' WHEN 'aurora_oom_reserved_mem_enter_kb' THEN 'Memory threshold (KB) to enter RESERVED state' WHEN 'aurora_oom_reserved_mem_exit_kb' THEN 'Memory threshold (KB) to exit RESERVED state' WHEN 'aurora_oom_status' THEN 'Current OOM status: NORMAL (sufficient memory) or RESERVED (low memory)' WHEN 'aurora_temptable_max_ram_allocation' THEN 'Peak memory (bytes) used by internal temporary tables since restart' WHEN 'aurora_temptable_ram_allocation' THEN 'Current memory (bytes) used by internal temporary tables' ELSE 'Aurora memory metric' END AS Details FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('aurora_oom_status', 'aurora_oom_avoidance_recovery_state', 'aurora_oom_reserved_mem_enter_kb', 'aurora_oom_reserved_mem_exit_kb', 'Aurora_reserved_mem_exceeded_incidents', 'Aurora_zdr_oom_threshold', 'Aurora_lockmgr_memory_used', 'Aurora_lockmgr_buffer_pool_memory_used', 'aurora_temptable_ram_allocation', 'aurora_temptable_max_ram_allocation') ORDER BY VARIABLE_NAME

queries.description: Shows all InnoDB configuration variables. Comprehensive view of InnoDB tuning parameters.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES LIKE 'innodb_%'

queries.description: Shows InnoDB undo tablespace counts (total, implicit, explicit, active).

scaling_factor.note: Reads server status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE variable_name IN ('Innodb_undo_tablespaces_total', 'Innodb_undo_tablespaces_implicit', 'Innodb_undo_tablespaces_explicit', 'Innodb_undo_tablespaces_active')

queries.description: Shows InnoDB redo log status including enabled state, capacity, and LSN positions. MySQL-only (not Aurora).

scaling_factor.note: Reads server status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE variable_name IN ('Innodb_redo_log_enabled', 'Innodb_redo_log_capacity_resized', 'Innodb_redo_log_checkpoint_lsn', 'Innodb_redo_log_current_lsn', 'Innodb_redo_log_flushed_to_disk_lsn')

queries.description: Checks if the events_transactions_current consumer is enabled. Required for PFS-based transaction monitoring.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema setup table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT ENABLED FROM performance_schema.setup_consumers WHERE NAME = 'events_transactions_current'

queries.description: Lists all active InnoDB transactions with duration, locked rows, and current query. Uses information_schema.innodb_trx.

scaling_factor.note: Holds the InnoDB trx_sys mutex while scanning active transactions; scales with active transaction count. Gated behind requires_extended_checks.

queries.command: SELECT trx_id, trx_state, trx_started, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, trx_started, NOW()) AS duration_seconds, trx_mysql_thread_id, trx_query, trx_rows_locked, trx_rows_modified FROM information_schema.innodb_trx ORDER BY trx_started

queries.description: Lists active transactions using Performance Schema events_transactions_current. Safer alternative to I_S.innodb_trx.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema transaction events; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT t.EVENT_ID AS trx_id, t.STATE AS trx_state, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL (t.TIMER_WAIT/1000000000000) SECOND) AS trx_started, ROUND(t.TIMER_WAIT/1000000000000, 0) AS duration_seconds, th.PROCESSLIST_ID AS trx_mysql_thread_id, t.ISOLATION_LEVEL, t.AUTOCOMMIT, th.PROCESSLIST_USER, t.GTID FROM performance_schema.events_transactions_current t JOIN performance_schema.threads th ON t.THREAD_ID = th.THREAD_ID WHERE t.STATE = 'ACTIVE' AND th.PROCESSLIST_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.TIMER_START

queries.description: Returns the InnoDB history list length (unpurged undo logs). High values indicate purge lag. MySQL/Aurora variant.

scaling_factor.note: Reads InnoDB internal metrics from information_schema.innodb_metrics; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT COUNT AS history_list_length FROM information_schema.innodb_metrics WHERE NAME = 'trx_rseg_history_len' and STATUS='enabled'

queries.description: Returns the InnoDB history list length. MariaDB variant (uses ENABLED column instead of STATUS).

scaling_factor.note: Reads InnoDB internal metrics from information_schema.innodb_metrics; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT COUNT AS history_list_length FROM information_schema.innodb_metrics WHERE NAME = 'trx_rseg_history_len' and ENABLED=1

queries.description: Shows InnoDB change buffer metrics. Tracks buffered secondary index changes. MySQL variant.

scaling_factor.note: Reads InnoDB internal metrics from information_schema.INNODB_METRICS; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT NAME, COUNT AS current_value, STATUS FROM information_schema.INNODB_METRICS WHERE SUBSYSTEM = 'change_buffer' ORDER BY NAME

queries.description: Shows InnoDB change buffer metrics. MariaDB variant (uses ENABLED column).

scaling_factor.note: Reads InnoDB internal metrics from information_schema.INNODB_METRICS; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT NAME, COUNT AS current_value, ENABLED FROM information_schema.INNODB_METRICS WHERE SUBSYSTEM = 'change_buffer' ORDER BY NAME

queries.description: Lists active InnoDB purge threads and their current state.

scaling_factor.note: Reads pre-aggregated Performance Schema threads table; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT THREAD_ID AS 'Thread ID', NAME AS 'Thread Name', TYPE AS 'Thread Type', PROCESSLIST_STATE AS 'State' FROM performance_schema.threads WHERE NAME LIKE '%purge%' ORDER BY THREAD_ID

queries.description: Shows InnoDB purge tuning parameters: threads, batch size, max lag, and max lag delay.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT 'innodb_purge_threads' AS 'Parameter', @@innodb_purge_threads AS 'Value', 'Good for most workloads' AS 'Recommendation' UNION ALL SELECT 'innodb_purge_batch_size', @@innodb_purge_batch_size, 'Number of undo log pages purged in one batch (300-5000 typical)' UNION ALL SELECT 'innodb_max_purge_lag', @@innodb_max_purge_lag, 'Disabled - no throttling of DML when history list is high' UNION ALL SELECT 'innodb_max_purge_lag_delay', @@innodb_max_purge_lag_delay, 'Maximum delay imposed on DML when max_purge_lag exceeded'

queries.description: Shows purge thread count and undo tablespace status.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables and status counters; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT @@innodb_purge_threads AS 'Purge Threads', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_undo_tablespaces_total') AS 'Undo Tablespaces', (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_undo_tablespaces_active') AS 'Active Undo Tablespaces'

queries.description: Summarizes key InnoDB configuration parameters with recommendations.

scaling_factor.note: Reads server variables; negligible overhead.

queries.command: SELECT 'innodb_buffer_pool_size (GB)' AS 'Parameter', ROUND(@@innodb_buffer_pool_size / 1073741824, 2) AS 'Value', 'Should be 70-80% of available RAM' AS 'Recommendation' UNION ALL SELECT 'innodb_buffer_pool_instances', @@innodb_buffer_pool_instances, '8-16 instances for large buffer pools' UNION ALL SELECT 'innodb_purge_threads', @@innodb_purge_threads, 'Threads for purging old row versions'
